Subject: [Updated 1:00PM] Rider Alert 11/4 Golden Gate Ferry Larkspur
TextBody:
[Updated 1:00PM] Wednesday 11/4, due to a mechanical issue, Golden Gate Ferry is planning to operate the following temporary schedule for the remainder of the day, but there may be changes. We appreciate your patience.


If you're trip is being replaced by bus service, please note the updated drop off and pickup locations in San Francisco *due to the Valkyries parade. [ https://valkyries.wnba.com/news/golden-state-valkyries-announce-championship-parade-information ]*


  * Bus drop off location* UNTIL 6PM *in SF is at Mission & 1st St [ https://maps.app.goo.gl/h4vJtcxdWsjv8uDV6 ] 
  * Bus drop off location* AFTER 6PM* is the SF Ferry Terminal 
  * Bus pickup location* UNTIL 6PM *in SF is at (look for bus with head sign #197) *Salesforce Transit Center Bay A. [ https://maps.app.goo.gl/dVS13C1vvjwebgeEA ]* 
  * Bus pickup location* AFTER 6PM* in SF resumes from Embarcadero & Washington [ https://maps.app.goo.gl/AepsmJkSHhFft8RSA ]. 
  * Please note bike capacity is limited on buses and travel times are closer to 55 minutes depending on traffic.  

*Larkspur - San Francisco*

1:00 PM delayed to 1:15PM via ferry  
*2:10 PM via bus* - drop off at Mission & 1st 
3:05 PM regular ferry 
*4:05 PM via bus* - drop off at Mission & 1st 
4:35 PM regular ferry 
*5:15 PM cancelled* 
6:10 PM regular ferry 
*7:15 PM via bus* - drop off at Ferry terminal

*San Francisco - Larkspur*

1:45 PM regular ferry 
*3:10 PM via bus* - pickup at Salesforce 
3:50 PM regular ferry 
4:30 PM ferry, 55-minute crossing, arriving at 5:25 PM 
5:25 PM regular ferry *5:35 PM* *cancelled*  
*6:00 PM via bus* - pickup at Embarcadero & Washington 
6:55 PM regular ferry 
*8:00 PM via bus* - pickup at Embarcadero & Washington

We appreciate your patience!
